requirements.title: Inventory of authorized and unauthorized software
requirements.description: An inventory of authorized and unauthorized software should be maintained. This includes software on all systems, including servers, workstations, network devices, and mobile devices.

requirements.title: Test for unauthorized software
requirements.description: Systems should be tested for unauthorized software. This includes testing for software that is not approved or that is not properly licensed.

requirements.title: Verify software inventory
requirements.description: The software inventory should be verified on a regular basis to ensure accuracy. This includes verifying that all software is properly licensed and authorized.

requirements.title: Inventory of authorized and unauthorized hardware
requirements.description: An inventory of authorized and unauthorized hardware should be maintained. This includes hardware on all systems, including servers, workstations, network devices, and mobile devices.

requirements.title: Test for unauthorized hardware
requirements.description: Systems should be tested for unauthorized hardware. This includes testing for hardware that is not approved or that is not properly licensed.

requirements.title: Inventory of authorized and unauthorized network devices
requirements.description: An inventory of authorized and unauthorized network devices should be maintained. This includes routers, switches, firewalls, and other network infrastructure.

requirements.title: Test for unauthorized network devices
requirements.description: Network devices should be tested for unauthorized devices. This includes testing for devices that are not approved or that are not properly licensed.

requirements.title: Verify architecture diagrams
requirements.description: Architecture diagrams should be verified to ensure they accurately represent the current system architecture. This includes verifying that all components are properly documented and that the diagrams are up-to-date.

requirements.title: Review architecture for security controls
requirements.description: The architecture should be reviewed to ensure that appropriate security controls are in place. This includes reviewing the architecture for authentication, authorization, encryption, and logging.

requirements.title: Verify security architecture
requirements.description: The security architecture should be verified to ensure that it is properly implemented and that all security controls are in place. This includes verifying that the architecture meets the requirements of the organization's security policy.

requirements.title: Verify data flow diagrams
requirements.description: Data flow diagrams should be verified to ensure they accurately represent the current data flows. This includes verifying that all data flows are properly documented and that the diagrams are up-to-date.

requirements.title: Review data flows for security controls
requirements.description: Data flows should be reviewed to ensure that appropriate security controls are in place. This includes reviewing the data flows for authentication, authorization, encryption, and logging.

requirements.title: Verify authentication mechanism
requirements.description: The authentication mechanism should be verified to ensure it is properly implemented. This includes verifying that the authentication mechanism meets the requirements of the organization's security policy.

requirements.title: Test authentication mechanism
requirements.description: The authentication mechanism should be tested to ensure it is properly implemented. This includes testing the authentication mechanism for vulnerabilities such as brute force attacks, credential stuffing, and session fixation.

requirements.title: Verify multi-factor authentication
requirements.description: Multi-factor authentication should be verified to ensure it is properly implemented. This includes verifying that multi-factor authentication is required for all users and that it is properly configured.

requirements.title: Verify session management
requirements.description: Session management should be verified to ensure it is properly implemented. This includes verifying that sessions are properly managed and that session tokens are properly protected.

requirements.title: Test session management
requirements.description: Session management should be tested to ensure it is properly implemented. This includes testing for session fixation, session hijacking, and session timeout.

requirements.title: Verify password policies
requirements.description: Password policies should be verified to ensure they meet the requirements of the organization's security policy. This includes verifying that passwords are properly stored and that password policies are properly enforced.

requirements.title: Test password policies
requirements.description: Password policies should be tested to ensure they are properly implemented. This includes testing for weak passwords, password reuse, and password storage.

requirements.title: Verify authorization mechanism
requirements.description: The authorization mechanism should be verified to ensure it is properly implemented. This includes verifying that the authorization mechanism meets the requirements of the organization's security policy.

requirements.title: Test authorization mechanism
requirements.description: The authorization mechanism should be tested to ensure it is properly implemented. This includes testing for privilege escalation, horizontal privilege escalation, and vertical privilege escalation.

requirements.title: Verify role-based access control
requirements.description: Role-based access control should be verified to ensure it is properly implemented. This includes verifying that roles are properly defined and that access control policies are properly enforced.
